name: Pixplet Media Library
author: Pixplet

sections.description:
Pixplet Media Library brings the Pixplet image library directly into the WordPress admin area. Search for free stock images, preview them, import them into the Media Library, and set a featured image without leaving the editor.

Features include:

  • Browse and search Pixplet images inside WordPress
  • Import images into the WordPress Media Library
  • Set imported images as featured images from the editor sidebar
  • Browse by category
  • Open the original image page on Pixplet
  • Store Pixplet source metadata on imported attachments

Pixplet gives WordPress users access to a growing library of completely free stock images for blogs, business websites, social media, landing pages, and creative projects.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/pixplet-media-library directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open Media > Pixplet Library to browse and import images.
  4. Open any supported post type with featured images enabled to use the Pixplet Featured Image sidebar panel.
sections.faq:
Do I need an account to use Pixplet Media Library?

No. Pixplet is free to use and does not require an account for image browsing or downloads.

Can I use Pixplet images for commercial projects?

Pixplet images are intended for personal and commercial projects according to the Pixplet license terms. Review the image page on Pixplet when you need full usage details.

Does the plugin connect to an external service?

Yes. The plugin retrieves image data from the public Pixplet API and downloads the selected image when you choose to import it into your WordPress Media Library.
